messages:
Elena Park: Heads-up team — Jordan (new SWE) starts Mon 7/14. I sketched a compact Day0/Week1 ops-ready checklist for managers + HR. Please review and flag anything missing.

Samir Patel: Thanks Elena. This looks great — adding a few HR policy/benefits items.

Elena Park: Day0 (before day 1):
- Confirm hardware request: MacBook Pro 14 or approved thin-client, 16GB RAM min, SSD. Submit imaging + asset tag to IT.
- Create accounts: GitHub org, Slack, Okta, Confluence, Jira. Set initial group memberships (eng, security-read).
- Access: ensure read-only on prod logs, redwood-console dev seat, and redwood-models-catalog view for learning.
- Licenses: add to Zoom lic + Google Workspace.
- Assign buddy & onboarding tasks in Jira: tag buddy with `onboard-buddy` label.
- Calendar: block Day1 AM 1h manager welcome, Day1 PM 1h environment setup, and recurring weekly 1:1 for first 90 days.

Elena Park: Day1 agenda (hours approximated):
- 09:00 - 09:30 Manager welcome (expectations, team context, org chart)
- 09:30 - 10:00 HR intros (benefits, payroll, code of conduct)
- 10:15 - 12:00 Dev env setup + clone onboarding repo (buddy pair)
- 12:00 - 13:00 Team lunch (in-person / virtual rotator)
- 13:00 - 15:00 Security & compliance quickfire (password managers, keys, secret scanning)
- 15:00 - 17:00 First task: fix small infra doc + open PR (walkthrough with buddy)

Aisha Tan: Love the timeboxed Day1. Suggest adding a 15m intro to Redwood Console metrics for engineers.

Elena Park: Good call — added 14:30 quick tour.

Samir Patel: HR asks to confirm I-9 documents received on Day0, add optional benefits Q/A drop-in at Day2 11:30. Also, ensure privacy training link is in the welcome packet.

it-ops-bot: Running `create-ticket --queue=it-setup --summary="Start image & VPN for Jordan R." --assignee=imaging`

it-ops-bot: Ticket created: IT-4872. VPN quickstart: https://internal.redwood/vpn-quickstart (SSO + U2F required).

Jordan Reyes: Quick q — will I get Dedicated environment access immediately? I want to follow the runtime walkthrough on Day2.

Elena Park: We'll request read-only Dedicated first day and escalate PR access on Day7 after manager approval. @it-ops-bot please add Jordan to `dedicated-readers`.

it-ops-bot: Added Jordan Reyes to dedicated-readers. Access ticket ACL-921 opened for escalation. :white_check_mark:

Aisha Tan: Buddy checklist (week1):
- Pair on onboarding repo: `github.com/redwood/onboarding` -> `first-pr.md` (small doc update).
- Walkthrough of local dev container: `./devcontainer.json` and `scripts/dev-setup.sh`
- Run `make test-unit` and `make lint`
- Observe a small runtime smoke test on the staging console
- Shadow a feature triage sync on Wed 10:00

Elena Park: Sample 30/60/90 (make measurable & manager-owned):
- 30d: Complete onboarding tasks, merge first two non-doc PRs, own one small bugfix end-to-end, weekly syncs with buddy documented.
- 60d: Ship a minor feature with tests and observability, own on-call rotation runbook entry, reduce a CI flake by 50%.
- 90d: Lead a rollout of a minor config change on Redwood Console with rollback plan, mentor a junior on a feature, present a short demo at team retro.

Samir Patel: HR guidance on expectations: ensure 30/60/90 goals are shared with new hire by Day5, and reviewed at 30/60/90 checkpoints in 1:1s. Provide calibration notes for performance rubric.

Jordan Reyes: Thanks — very clear. Where's the onboarding repo and the "first PR" instructions?

Aisha Tan: Repo: `git@github.com:redwood/onboarding.git`. First PR: update `docs/quick-start.md` with a short paragraph about your dev setup and a screenshot. Use branch `onboarding/<your-name>/first-pr`.

Elena Park: Manager action items (short checklist):
- Send welcome note + intro threads in #eng (optional photo).
- Confirm hardware & imaging complete by Fri EOD before start.
- Add calendar invites & share Day1 schedule.
- Approve initial 30/60/90 draft by Day5 and post to Confluence.
- Ensure buddy has time blocked for at least 4 x 2h pairing sessions in week1.

it-ops-bot: Reminder set — ping manager 48h before start for final checks.

Jordan Reyes: All set on my side. Any docs I should read over the weekend?

Samir Patel: Please skim Code of Conduct, Security Basics, and Privacy playbook. Links posted in DM. Also optional pre-work: install dev tools listed in `docs/dev-setup.md`.

Elena Park: Thanks everyone. I'll post the finalized calendar and Confluence page tonight. Ping here for any last-minute access problems. :rocket:
